artworks.title: Henri II as Tiphys
artworks.description: French royal-entry allegory: Henri II cast as Tiphys at the helm — the Argonaut steersman as Renaissance emblem of the king who guides the ship of state.

artworks.title: Building the Argo
artworks.description: British Museum terracotta relief: Athena oversees the building of the Argo — Tiphys' ship under construction, the vessel he will steer to Colchis.

artworks.title: Tiphys Batavus (frontispiece)
artworks.description: Frontispiece to Snellius' Tiphys Batavus — the Argonaut helmsman's name borrowed for a Dutch treatise on navigation, Tiphys as early-modern science's steersman.
